result.summary: Rejected. (1) validateInclusion in Registry/Semantic.lean is weakened: sub and super are checked at independent fresh metavariables (subArgs, superArgs) instead of the declaration's own parameters, and obligations are deferred to use sites. This is an admission rule loosened to let puncturedUnits in. (2) The leaf contract (CasContract/Registry/Extension.lean) gains a `binder` semantic row via RegistryEntry and toSemantic/ofSemantic. (3) The kernel's division path catches every exception from applyNamed and rethrows it as `.invalid`, which collapses failure kinds. (4) The change is far too large and mixed to review: split it into the generic kernel binder reading alone, the validateBinder proposal alone, and each mathematics file separately under unweakened rules. Drop the leaf-contract addition and the validateInclusion relaxation.
